title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
abstract: arXiv:2611.24381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place. Every unit of the circuit is a 0/1 predicate on tokens, and every map between predicates is a minimised truth table. Short tables, such as the product of a query code and a key code, are minimised exactly, and wide feature-to-feature transitions become implication rules by noise-tolerant minimisation. Blocks are replaced one at a time from the output down, in the manner of the Ship of Theseus, and after each replacement the remaining soft part re-adapts to the frozen circuit. Attention selection takes two forms, a row-wise comparison of integer scores (order selection) and a learned rule (rule selection). Both are fitted on the ordinary training set alone, and only on the examples that the teacher classifies correctly, so that the circuit imitates the teacher where the teacher is right. translated_title: 如何将注意力神经网络转化为可解释的硬逻辑谓词电路：忒修斯之船式替换下的真值表谓词提取与状态机合并
translated_abstract: 我们将一个训练好的注意力网络作为一个整体（包括注意力机制本身）转换为可在其位置运行的硬逻辑谓词电路。电路的每个单元都是关于词元的0/1谓词，谓词之间的每个映射都是一个最小化的真值表。较短的表（如查询码与键码的乘积）采用精确方法最小化，而宽的特征到特征的转换则通过容噪最小化转化为蕴含规则。模块从输出端开始逐个被替换，如同忒修斯之船的方式，每次替换后，剩余的软性部分会重新适应已冻结的电路。注意力选择采用两种形式：整数分数的逐行比较（顺序选择）和学到的规则（规则选择）。两者仅在普通训练集上拟合，且只在教师分类正确的样本上进行拟合，从而使电路在教师正确之处模仿教师。在TweetEval-emotion上，……
tldr: 该论文提出一种“忒修斯之船”式逐块替换方法，将训练好的注意力网络（包括注意力机制本身）整体转化为由0/1谓词与最小化真值表构成的硬逻辑谓词电路，既保持可解释性又能在教师正确的样本上忠实模仿教师。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Ship-of-Theseus block-by-block replacement approach that converts a trained attention network—including the attention mechanism itself—into an interpretable hard-logic predicate circuit built from 0/1 predicates and minimised truth tables, which imitates the teacher only where the teacher is correct.
